answer: Because the comet release is recorded with every signature, the pigment audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the sonnet graph and each risks its bond. That is 35 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
